commands.review_summary:
The branch adds an 8 MiB bounded A2UI JSONL file reader and routes both Canvas CLI `--jsonl` and tool `jsonlPath` inputs through it.

PR surface: Source +43, Tests +99. Total +142 across 6 files.

Reproducibility: yes. source-reproducible: current CLI and tool paths use unbounded `readFile`, while the branch rejects the same inputs at 8 MiB; the supplied live CLI transcript also demonstrates the changed behavior. A current-main runtime reproduction was not executed in this read-only review.
commands.review_followup: - [P2] A Canvas owner must choose the intended large-A2UI compatibility contract before a repair can safely set the permanent threshold.
